about: Canonical cameras shared by the WebGL reference (repo root dev server, ?shot hook in src/ocean.js) and the WebGPU demo (world-ocean/demo). cam = x,y,z (m, +Y up),yawDeg (0 = towards -Z, + towards +X),pitchDeg (+ up). Reference sun azimuth is yaw -53 deg. Scenes are the reference presets golden (sun 10 deg), azure (sun 50 deg), storm (sun 38 deg, windiest, reference default); the demo matches them with ?scene= (sky stand-in + core breeze preset at REFERENCE_SCENE_AMPLITUDE[scene]). Every shot warms up 6 s at a fixed 1/60 s step before t (foam history), then pauses. Whale hidden in the reference (creature=0). set "canonical" = the 6 infra shots (t = 10 s); set "reference-md" = cameras C1-C7 x 3 scenes from docs/port/REFERENCE.md §5 (t = 30 s). Capture: node tools/capture.mjs --batch tools/shots.json --target reference|demo --base <url> --outdir <dir> [--set canonical] [--only name,...].
